brief:
Settlers dumped waste at the entrance of al-Mughayyir school east of Ramallah while Israeli military forces provided protection, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident occurred in the village of al-Mughayyir, where tensions between Palestinians and Israeli settlers have been a recurring concern.

The action represents another episode of alleged settler harassment targeting Palestinian civilians and institutions in the occupied West Bank.
title: Settlers dump waste at Palestinian school entrance under Israeli military protection
